- NASA’s long‑term goal is to send astronauts to the Martian surface in the 2030s (the “Mars 2030” timeline is still under study).  
- SpaceX’s Starship, which is being tested for interplanetary flights, has a target of a crewed Mars landing sometime in the 2030s–2040s, but no launch has been scheduled yet.  
- Other agencies (ESA, CNSA, Roscosmos, etc.) are also researching crewed Mars concepts, but no concrete launch dates have been announced.
